decls.description: The cluster's demand for one SKU in one role.
A machine observed after the order, with the disks it reports.

lines: // A machine belongs to a cluster through the plan hash it was ordered under.
plan_machine(c, m) :- cluster__plan_hash(c, p), machine__plan_hash(m, p).
// A machine is invalid unless each slot has exactly one value, its disks differ,
// and neither disk appears on another machine of the plan.
invalid_machine(c, m) :- plan_machine(c, m), machine__plan_hash(m, a), machine__plan_hash(m, b), a != b.
invalid_machine(c, m) :- plan_machine(c, m), machine__sku(m, a), machine__sku(m, b), a != b.
invalid_machine(c, m) :- plan_machine(c, m), machine__address(m, a), machine__address(m, b), a != b.
invalid_machine(c, m) :- plan_machine(c, m), machine__boot_disk(m, a), machine__boot_disk(m, b), a != b.
invalid_machine(c, m) :- plan_machine(c, m), machine__data_disk(m, a), machine__data_disk(m, b), a != b.
invalid_machine(c, m) :- plan_machine(c, m), machine__boot_disk(m, d), machine__data_disk(m, d).
invalid_machine(c, m) :- plan_machine(c, m), plan_machine(c, n), m != n,
// A line is invalid unless each slot has exactly one value: an unknown slot never passes.
invalid_line(c, l) :- line__cluster(l, c), line__sku(l, a), line__sku(l, b), a != b.
invalid_line(c, l) :- line__cluster(l, c), line__role(l, a), line__role(l, b), a != b.
invalid_line(c, l) :- line__cluster(l, c), line__quantity(l, a), line__quantity(l, b), a != b.
named_sku(c, s) :- line__cluster(l, c), line__sku(l, s).
.decl valid_sku(cluster: symbol, sku: symbol, machine: symbol)
valid_sku(c, s, m) :- valid_machine(c, m), machine__sku(m, s).
shape_problem(c, "count") :- line__cluster(l, c), line__sku(l, s), line__quantity(l, q),
n = count : { valid_sku(c, s, _) }, n != q.
shape_problem(c, "count") :- line__cluster(l, c), line__sku(l, s), line__quantity(l, q),
shape_problem(c, "unassigned") :- valid_machine(c, m), machine__sku(m, s), !named_sku(c, s).
shape_problem(c, "ambiguous_line") :- line__cluster(a, c), line__cluster(b, c), a != b,
// Only a cluster without any problem has a shape.
.decl member(cluster: symbol, machine: symbol, role: symbol)
member(c, m, r) :- cluster(c), !has_problem(c), valid_machine(c, m), machine__sku(m, s),
line__cluster(l, c), line__sku(l, s), line__role(l, r).
.decl ceph_device(cluster: symbol, machine: symbol, disk: symbol)
ceph_device(c, m, d) :- member(c, m, _), machine__data_disk(m, d).
api_address(c, a) :- member(c, m, "controller"), machine__address(m, a).
ceph_device_count(c, n) :- cluster(c), !has_problem(c), n = count : { ceph_device(c, _, _) }.

module.description: Demand and observed machines from which the shape of a run cluster is derived.
